verdict.rationale: The only MCP evidence covers connecting MCP servers to Copilot Chat in the IDE, not inside GitHub Mobile. Nothing in the pack shows the mobile app itself, or the Copilot experience within it, letting users plug in MCP servers and use their tools. An AI-capable mobile client could plausibly offer this, so the axis applies and lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
